verdict.rationale: LocalAI is self-hosted and uses open standards (OpenAI-compatible API, GGUF model files, open runtime) so a user's data and configuration are inherently local and portable rather than locked into a vendor cloud, and the docs emphasize an open, standards-based architecture (localai-docs-1, localai-docs-15, localai-docs-32, localai-docs-26). However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated data-export mechanism (chat history, agent configs, usage logs) or migration tooling. Missing for 10: explicit export/backup feature docs, independent confirmation that all user data (chats, configs) is stored in open, exportable formats.
